theme: Source-qualified fine graphic variation across cities
question: Does city improve prediction of fine sign variants after graphic context, carrier, material, motif, preservation and source volume are known, and which exact shared frames have enough source-qualified support?
outcome: On 306 confirmation components in nine Mayig graphic compatibility families, the site-conditioned model loses 0.01584025 bits per target, bootstrap 95% interval -0.04106721 to +0.00610127. The useful-gain criterion was +0.03 bits with interval above zero; it fails, and every leave-one-family-out gain remains negative. Seals-only gain -0.01594502, qualified-CISI -0.02881076, excluding candidate accession collisions -0.01590824. The strict exact-frame tests have zero informative groups. Post-outcome source coverage identifies 16 cross-city variable frames over 57 physical families, nine frames over 28 families after carrier matching, and three frames over six families with carrier, motif, preservation and volume matched. Only one of those six objects has the unbracketed excavation-source qualification. The source layer covers 2879 objects with linked records; 2602 have CISI table locators, 1897 qualified excavation sources and 1134 excavation table locators. Fifteen repeated museum-key candidates reduce to thirteen source-value collisions and two parser fragments after literal-cell review. Four objects in two cross-city frames were visually inspected; M-1419 A matches exported face 3706.2.
challenge: The whole corpus and site statistic family were previously examined. Exact-frame matching has no informative cells under one-component scoring. Dates and independent workshop/style labels are unavailable. Graphic compatibility is supplied by one annotator and does not authenticate sounds or equivalence of meaning. Source-volume equality includes missing coverage, and one candidate pair has no held basic-data locator. The upstream museum parser can split comma punctuation inside accession values. The frozen protocol incorrectly described its >=200 cutoff as excluding fish: 49 discovery and 47 confirmation targets of fish code 240 entered broad selection, but failed the two-variant discovery support rule and supplied zero primary scores. The original files and scores remain preserved with an explicit scope correction. A nonpositive increment of this fitted model does not identify a common spoken language.
remedy: Freeze the protocol, code, grouping and predictions before one logged confirmation read; explicitly use spent exploratory access with a private ledger. Select one target per physical/text component, use fixed shrinkage and a +0.03-bit pass criterion, preserve eleven comparisons and leave-one-family-out results, report empty exact-frame support, and keep the post-outcome coverage audit separate. Preserve all original flags and scores, inspect literal source cells, assert no physical merges, keep raw rows local, and separately recompute all 306 probabilities and the interval. Generated city-spelling, motif-confounding and null controls calibrate the scorer. Shared-convention proposal credence 0.55; several-language and institutional mechanisms remain observationally equivalent.
retry_when: New independently sampled inscriptions with image-checked frames, source-qualified dates and manufacture, or independently coded carving-style/workshop labels become available; or a specific model change is justified before a new score. A new seed over these objects supplies no new population.

authors.model: GPT-6 family; exact model identifier not exposed
